requirement: Implement EPIC 1, Story 3: make grid edits and playback translate to exact pads while drums and bass use independent pattern-level banks.

architecture.decision: Keep banks at the Pattern root and resolve them only at audio entry points; derive pad highlighting from scheduled events rather than duplicating pad state in grid data.
alternatives: Store the bank on every drum hit and bass cell.
Add downloaded sample packs or a per-row effects editor.
tradeoffs: Root-level bank fields retimbre an entire instrument without mutating authored events.
Runtime voice/effect settings keep ROK assets unchanged and avoid new assets or dependencies.
seams: src/constants.ts and src/pattern.ts own Bank typing and immutable pattern-level state.
src/audio.ts resolves a bank plus pad/cell to its drum or bass voice.
src/App.tsx, src/TransportControls.tsx, and src/BeatPad.tsx project active mode banks and scheduled pad activity.

tasks.title: Record Story 3 and its execution plan
tasks.intent: Mark the next priority story in progress and persist its independently verifiable work queue.
tasks.acceptance: Both v1.1 trackers show Story 3 In progress and this plan is valid JSON.
tasks.result: Marked Story 3 In progress and created its durable execution plan.

tasks.title: Add bank-aware pattern state and audio routes
tasks.intent: Define the four banks, default both instruments to ROK, and resolve bank-specific generated/processed voices without changing event data.
constraints: Bank remains outside drum and bass event values.
tasks.acceptance: Pattern defaults to independent ROK banks; all listed audio entry points accept/read a bank; HIP/TEC/BOX use distinct runtime processing/voice settings.
tasks.result: Added Bank values and independent default pattern fields, then routed every drum/bass entry point through runtime ROK/HIP/TEC/BOX timbres over the retained assets.

tasks.title: Project mode-owned banks and scheduled pads in the UI
tasks.intent: Make the selector update only its active instrument and make scheduled grid events visibly light their exact pad.
constraints: Do not mutate events when changing a bank.
Keep the pad secondary to the full grid.
tasks.acceptance: Drum and bass mode expose their respective active bank; switching drums leaves bass bank and all events unchanged; scheduled drum/bass events visibly activate only their mapped pads.
tasks.visual: Clean-reload local desktop app; inspect both mode selectors and exact active pad projection.
tasks.result: Mode-owned selectors update only their instrument bank, and scheduled pattern events derive exact active pad wedges; drum grid commits no longer wait for audio decode.
evidence: clean-reload browser: Drum HIP and Bass TEC selections remained independent
clean-reload browser: drum grid event committed immediately
